# Rubric

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Rubric>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A norm for judging — a reified evaluation framework whose criteria, poles, scales, and anchors are first-class content. Being a [`Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), a rubric names its issuer (no anonymous evaluation standards), may be overridden, and carries authority within its issuing system. Applying a rubric is solver work; the results come back as vantage-indexed Assessments ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Member criteria attach via [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-hasCriterion.md) (⊑ [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
